explanation: The theorem says v ↦ l • H.mulVec v is surjective for H in SL(2,K) and l ≠ 0, where smulMulVec is the library's own definition. I searched Mathlib for mulVec surjectivity lemmas. The closest are Matrix.mulVec_surjective_iff_isUnit and Matrix.mulVec_surjective_of_invertible, in Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/NonsingularInverse.lean. They cover mulVec alone, not the scalar factor l. Deriving the theorem from them would mean composing with scalar multiplication by a unit and showing the matrix is a unit. That takes more than two short lines, so I did not count it as a special case. I found no lemma about the combined map.
